task: Produce an evidence map of the paper's method, registered results, caveats, and derived comparisons. Cite exact JSON pointers, label each conclusion as paper-stated or analyst-derived, and show the inputs for every calculation.

records.text: We evaluate persistent evidence ledgers on multi-document synthesis and report improved supported-claim recall with additional compute.
The treatment stores candidate claims with source locators, contradiction status, and an unresolved-question queue. The control receives the same documents and task but has no persistent ledger.
We registered 48 synthetic source packs across four domains, three seeds per pack, and a maximum of four recursive evidence passes for the treatment.
The preregistered primary endpoint is supported-claim recall. The treatment mean was 0.84 and the control mean was 0.73.
Supported-claim precision was 0.96 for treatment and 0.97 for control.
Median end-to-end latency was 128 seconds for treatment and 82 seconds for control.
The results support further evaluation of persistent evidence state; they do not establish general superiority outside the registered synthetic tasks.
Two attempts were excluded before scoring because the fixture archive was truncated. Both exclusions affected the control arm and were replaced under the registered policy.
Across pack-level means, the treatment standard deviation was 0.041 and the control standard deviation was 0.038.
The evaluator used synthetic, fully enumerated facts. Performance on open-world research and private corpora was not measured.
The target role requires designing grounded-agent evaluations, explaining cost-quality tradeoffs, and identifying claims that exceed experimental evidence.
